scope: Ordinary black-border Legends. Gold and other materials fit independently, both choosing the same translation. No change to other sets or explicit frame templates.
method: Shared translations fit only on training cards. Real painter replay, unchanged scan poses and no changes below the title strip. Scores are title-only two-polarity edge F1, not full-card accuracy.
cohort: UUID order before measurements; alternating training/validation. Frozen scan-only poses. Canvas title layers checked against real full render. Gold and other printed materials evaluated separately.
remaining: Title font size/width and printing texture still differ on some cards.
Mana, type, rules, set symbols, artist and P/T are separate pending fits.

normalizationReview.note: Original measurements preserved. Corrected frame, color, title/type/symbol rechecks and fresh text validation are reported separately, including retained regressions.
